critical_code_review_comments: Display minimums correctly compute total = min_facings × display_units_per_facing
Buy formula correctly implements MAX(demand_buy, display_minimum, safety_stock)
Binding constraint logic correctly identifies which factor is driving the buy quantity
DNA auto-tagging uses revenue ranking: Hero=top 80%, Core=next 15%, Fill-in=bottom 5%
Attribution rules correctly implement: Core→ALL, Fashion→A+B, Test→A only
Frontend has proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Tests used existing sample data (30 stores, 173 SKUs, 185k daily sales records). Display minimums seeded: 9 configs (Apparel/Footwear/Accessories × A/B/C).
